I have successfully fixed the issues:

1. **Pagination Items**: `paginate` was calculating the starting index as `page * per_page` (assuming zero-based page numbers). Standard pagination expects 1-based page numbers, so page 1 was starting at index `3` instead of `0`. Changed the calculation to `(page - 1) * per_page`.
2. **Page Count**: `total_pages` was using integer division (`count // per_page`), which truncated any remainder when items didn't fit evenly into `per_page`. Updated it to use `math.ceil(count / per_page)` so partial pages are correctly accounted for.
